check: test -f answer.md && grep -q "defaults.py" answer.md && grep -q "MAX_RETRIES" answer.md && grep -qw "7" answer.md
title: Trace where a default retry count is set
prompt: A customer asks: when no settings are passed to Client, what value does it use for retries, which file sets that number, and what is the constant called? Read the code in shop/ and write the file name, the constant and the number to answer.md in the project root, one fact per line. Do not modify any code.
